BEA has no pagination: narrow parameters_json to fit a bounded response; max_rows explicitly caps returned rows. Numeric values retain published units; unit_multiplier is the base-10 exponent and is not applied automatically. Suppressed values become NULL, with original value_text and notes preserved. NULL arguments are rejected. Missing optional response fields return NULL. Upstream errors fail the query; SQL WHERE filters are local.
